data_root.description: Path to the directory where Docker stores data (images, containers, volumes, etc.).

default_runtime.description: Default OCI runtime to use for running containers.

dns.description: List of DNS servers for containers to use for name resolution.

dns_search.description: List of DNS search domains for containers.

hosts.description: List of addresses for the Docker daemon to listen on (e.g., tcp://0.0.0.0:2375, unix:///var/run/docker.sock).

insecure_registries.description: List of private registry hostnames/IPs that are allowed to use HTTP or HTTPS with untrusted certificates.

log_opts.description: Options for the default logging driver (e.g., max-size, max-file). If null or empty, no specific options are set beyond defaults.

runtimes.description: Additional OCI-compliant runtimes available for use (e.g., 'runsc' for gVisor, 'kata' for Kata Containers). Each entry maps a name to path and args. If null, no additional runtimes are defined.

storage_driver.description: Storage driver to use for managing container layers (e.g., overlay2, vfs, btrfs). Must be supported by the host filesystem.
